visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands before a night cityscape background featuring the illuminated Taipei 101 tower. An infographic showing the James Webb Space Telescope is positioned in the upper portion of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a detailed graphical representation of a crystalline ice structure, resembling a complex snowflake with sharp, geometric branches, set against a dark blue gradient background. (3) The view returns to the man in the black shirt. He uses active hand gestures, opening and closing his palms to emphasize his points. The lighting is bright and focused on his face and torso. (4) A computer-generated animation depicts a distant solar system with a central bright star and a prominent, glowing ring of dust and debris. The background is the deep black of space with scattered stars. (5) The man reappears on screen, speaking directly to the viewer with a friendly expression. He continues to gesture frequently with both hands before the video ends with a steady shot of him talking.

A soft, ambient electronic background track provides a subtle rhythmic bed. The recording is studio-clean with minimal room tone. (2) The narrator's pitch variability increases, showing more dynamic intonation as he describes technical discoveries like crystalline ice. The BGM maintains its tempo and volume level, remaining distinct but non-intrusive beneath the clear vocal track. (3) The speech remains continuous and well-articulated, with brief pauses for emphasis between sentences. There is a consistent frequency balance with clear high frequencies for vocal clarity and a warm mid-range for the music. The background music continues steadily until the vocal concludes, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Contextual Introduction -> Scientific Discovery Details -> Comparison with Solar System -> Future Significance -> Humorous Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To inform and educate the audience about the James Webb Space Telescope's discovery of crystalline ice in the HD 181327 star system, explaining its significance for understanding the origins of water in our own solar system and the potential habitability of other planets.
